thread:
sam: Heads-up — Azure sent back a counterproposal on the EDP. They pushed a higher GPU floor but offered stronger regional failover credits. Need quick alignment on what we can accept before Friday.
priya: can you paste the key redlines? i'm in a planning sync rn.
alex: pulling the PDF now. main points: 1) 12-month min commit at 40% of requested GPUs 2) 6-month ramp to reach full commit 3) regional conversion allowed but 10% penalty 4) availability credit: if capacity < 90% in region, 2x credits for affected hours (capped)
mira: 40% floor is brutal for our test+canary usage. What's the $ exposure? finance-bot: quick calc: if commit = $5.2M/year, 40% floor = $2.08M guaranteed. With our forecast we'll underutilize ~25% in year1 -> ~ $520k shadow spend vs on-demand.
oscar: we can argue for a smaller floor but add a stricter SLA credit. propose: 25% floor + regional failure credit + immediate true-up window if availability < 85% for 72h.
julia-azure: (azure) appreciate the quick review. From our side the 40% floor lets us guarantee capacity allocation for your fleet. We're open to reducing floor if you accept a 2-year term or larger upfront payment. Also can add a higher credit multiplier for multiregion outages.
sam: hmm. 2-year term isn't ideal. Could we instead ask for a shorter ramp and a convertibility clause: allow converting unused committed GPU hours to burst credits in other regions with no penalty for first 6 months?
julia-azure: we can do a limited convertibility pilot for first 3 months, no penalty, up to 20% of committed units. After pilot, standard conversion terms apply.
priya: counter ask: 1) reduce floor -> 30% year1, 35% year2 2) 90-day ramp with automatic scaling triggers 3) outage credit = 4x for sustained availability <85% for >48h 4) convert pilot 25% for 90 days
alex: copied into spreadsheet: https://redwoodshared.sheets/EDP-counter-1871122334 (internal)
mira: we should also insist on preemptible / spot carveouts — we don't want preemptible evictions to count against their availability SLA.
oscar: +1. add explicit carveout clause: "Spot/preemptible interruptions and maintenance events do not count toward uptime for committed capacity guarantees."
sam: draft clause I want in the email:
```
If Provider cannot deliver committed GPU capacity in a customer's contracted region for a continuous period exceeding 48 hours and does not provide equivalent capacity in a mutually agreed alternative region within 24 hours, Provider shall compensate Customer at 4x the hourly committed rate for the impacted units for the duration of the outage, up to a maximum of 30 days. Preemptible/spot interruptions, scheduled maintenance with 72-hour notice, and force majeure are excluded from this compensation.
```
julia-azure: that reads reasonable but we need to define "equivalent capacity" (SKU, interconnect, and region latency constraints). Also 4x might be high — we can meet 2x with a faster conversion guarantee.
finance-bot: from a P&L perspective 4x credit is ok as long as there's a hard cap and we keep convertibility options. credits are often applied to future invoices not cash refunds.
priya: negotiation playbook: trade term length for lower floor + stronger credits. also ask for a limited convertibility option and a clean true-up (monthly) vs annual true-up.
alex: ops note: make sure they commit to placement groups or availability sets for reserved pools so our network affinity and multi-AZ latency tests pass.
mira: action items: 1) sam to send counter email with the four asks above + the draft clause 2) alex to attach usage forecast and model scenarios 3) priya to run revised cost scenarios with 30/35 floors 4) oscar to draft the spot carveout wording 5) sam/priya to review vendor response on Friday EOD
sam: i'll draft and ping @julia-azure. can someone sign off on the legal-ish language? priya or alex?
priya: i'll take the legal-ish review. ping me the draft when ready.
oscar: +1 on the spot carveout wording, will DM a sample clause.
julia-azure: I'll take this back to pricing. If you can accept a slightly longer term (15 months) we'll see if we can move the floor to 30% and widen the convertibility pilot to 25% for the first quarter.
sam: thanks — will share draft in ~2h for signoff. :thumbsup:
mira: :rocket:
